info:
Welcome to GalaxySMP, a friendly Minecraft Bedrock server for everyone.

Survival, Minigames, Skyblock and Creative, all connected through one hub. Our staff keep things safe and fun, and it's free to play.

Website: galaxymc.us
- Community chat and voice chat (link your account with /link)
- Server status, the money leaderboard and the full rules

Server address: galaxymc.smp.live (port 9030)

rules.title: 1. Respect
items: **No bullying or harassment.** This includes name-calling, targeting a player repeatedly, or encouraging others to do so.
**No hate speech.** Comments about anyone's race, religion, gender, disability or identity are not allowed.
**Resolve disputes through staff.** If you have a problem with another player, contact a staff member rather than arguing in public.

rules.title: 2. Chat
items: **No swearing,** including misspellings or symbols used to get around the filter.
**No mature or frightening content.** Keep all topics suitable for younger players.
**No spam.** Avoid flooding chat, excessive capital letters or repeated messages.
**No advertising** of other servers, channels or websites.

rules.title: 3. Online safety
items: **Keep personal information private:** real names, ages, addresses, schools, phone numbers, photos and social media accounts.
**Never ask other players** for their personal information.
**Keep conversations on GalaxySMP.** If someone asks you to move to another app, tell a staff member.
**Never share your password.** Staff will never ask for it.

rules.title: 4. Fair play
items: **No griefing.** Do not break, alter or take from builds that aren't yours.
**No cheating.** Hacked clients, X-ray, auto-clickers and other unfair modifications are prohibited.
**Report bugs instead of exploiting them.** Players who report exploits may be rewarded.
**No scamming** or misleading players in trades.

rules.title: 5. Staff
items: **Follow staff instructions.** If you disagree with a decision, raise it politely with a staff member.
**Report problems** to staff instead of responding yourself.

commands.description: Open this menu: server info, rules and commands.
Link your account to galaxymc.us for chat and voice. Get the code on the website.
Send a teleport request to another player.
Ask another player to teleport to you.
Accept a teleport request.
Say no to a teleport request.
Go back to spawn.
Save where you're standing as a home (1 home, or more with Galaxy+ and Pro+).
Teleport to one of your homes.
List your homes.
Delete a home.
Go back to where you died or last teleported from.
See your subscription plan (Galaxy Free, Galaxy+ or Pro+).
Open your Plot Manager: members, highlight, teleport, unclaim.
Get a Plot Claiming Shovel if you can claim another plot.
Open the Minigame Center: host (Galaxy+), join or watch minigames. Same as the computers.
Teleport where you've been sent, like to the staff member who accepted your minigame.
See your money, or someone else's. Also /bal.
Send money to another player. 2.5k means $2,500.
See the richest players.
Buy and sell items by category.
Sell items: opens a menu, or sell what you hold, or everything.
Open the Auction House to buy from other players.
Sell the item in your hand on the Auction House for 48 hours.
Claim your daily reward: $100 on day 1 up to $700 on day 7 (plus a crate key). Don't miss a day!
See today's 3 quests (easy, medium, hard) and your progress. New quests every day.
See your achievements. Badges show on your galaxymc.us profile.
See your stats (playtime, blocks, mobs...) or another player's.
Pick a job (Miner, Lumberjack, Farmer, Hunter, Digger, Builder) and earn money while you play. Level up for up to 2x pay.
Claim a shop plot in the Shop District with your Plot Claiming Shovel. Hold an item and sneak + tap a chest there to make a shop chest.
Tap a crate at spawn to see the prizes and open it with a key. Keys: finish all /quests (Common), /shop (Common), day 7 of /daily (Rare).
Press a button next to an elevator to call it. Inside, tap the cabin floor to pick a floor. Galaxy+ and Pro+ can build them in their plots with /elevator.
Report a player who is breaking the rules. Staff get an alert right away.
Set the spawn point to where you're standing.
Set a player's money.
Give a player money.
Take money from a player.
Summon a shop NPC where you stand. Tap it to edit it.
Give, create and edit ranks.
Get the Plot Axe: make plots and protected areas (left-click, right-click, then Save).
List every plot and protected area.
Turn the chat filter on or off for everyone (bad words are scrambled).
Open the announcement panel: announce to everyone, or set up auto announcements.
Moderation panel: warn, mute, kick or ban players, see their history, and handle reports.
Block inspector on/off: break or tap a block to see who placed or broke it.
Undo a player's block changes (griefing) from a chosen time and area.
Place a floating leaderboard where you stand (money, playtime, miners...), or remove the nearest one.
Place or remove crates, edit prizes and chances, give keys, set the Common key price.
Give crate keys (works from the console too, e.g. for event prizes).
